adaptations: Kernel body byte-for-byte extracted from pinned upstream source
exp2 symbol bound to vLLM natural exponential; no gate-conversion kernel
SOLVE_TRIL_DOT_PRECISION matches vLLM FLA_TRIL_PRECISION (ieee by default)
FLA cache autotuner replaced by triton.autotune; upstream configurations retained
Only KKT and triangular solve replaced in copied full forward function

limitations: Single-GPU operator benchmark; TP shapes are per-rank equivalents, not distributed runs
Synthetic BF16 inputs, normalized q/k; no model-level throughput or accuracy claim
Graph mode is an isolated captured operator, not proof vLLM captures this path
Eager CUDA-event timelines can include GPU idle gaps caused by host submission
No cache flushing or clock locking; randomized paired rounds and telemetry recorded
Two GPUs run independent operator replicas, not a distributed model
Both replicas share the host; eager submission timing may be affected by concurrent CPU activity
Model config determines geometry only; weights and model activations are not loaded
Candidate changes KKT arithmetic as well as launch fusion; speedup cannot be assigned solely to fusion
